summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) end-to-end: implement API backend, owner UI, and recipient UI for write-enabled sharing, then conduct UAT and security review.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed and verified; 12 security issues discovered and fixed with TDD (8 backend unit tests + 4 E2E tests); 21 E2E tests passing; all code pushed to feat/phase-27-writable-shares.

repo: The cipher-box-ci-debug checkout does not have .env files committed — they must be copied from ../cipher-box/ manually each session
VITE_API_URL must be set explicitly in apps/web/.env; without it, the web app defaults to window.location.origin + '/api' (port 5173) instead of the API port 3000
SDK build order dependency chain: core → sdk-core → sdk → web; missing builds cause @cipherbox/sdk resolution failures in Vite

The auth controller defined its own local RequestWithUser interface extending NestJS @nestjs/common Request (Fetch API) instead of using common/types.ts which extends Express Request — causing type incompatibility in tests
NestJS watch mode does not always pick up DTO enum changes for OpenAPI spec generation; API must be fully restarted and api-docs-json re-checked to confirm OpenAPI spec reflects changes
Background tasks spawned via Bash run_in_background are killed when the conversation context shifts — use detached process patterns (nohup / disown) for dev servers
addShareKeys API endpoint constrained keyType to 'file' | 'folder' only; needed 'file-ipns' added to both DTO @IsIn validator and @ApiProperty enum
Shared uploads in useSharedNavigation previously set fileMetaIpnsName to empty string (PoC shortcut), making uploaded files unreadable
TextEditorDialog save path used owner's useFolder hook — completely wrong for shared files; required onSaveSharedFile callback prop wired through SharedFileBrowser
Owner file updates (handleUpdateFile in useFileOperations) did not re-wrap new file keys for share recipients — pre-existing gap that manifested during writable shares UAT
PostgreSQL host IP was hardcoded in .env (192.168.133.114) and changed to 192.168.133.12 during the session

code.finding: Original PoC set fileMetaIpnsName: '' on shared uploads, skipping per-file IPNS record creation entirely
withConflictRetry closures captured stale React state for currentSequenceNumber and folderChildren — fixed by adding refs alongside state and using refs inside closures
Checked item.fileMetaIpnsName which is empty for shared-uploaded files, producing misleading 'legacy v1 file' error
Shared file download path threw if no share_key found — was silently falling back to owner-wrapped fileKeyEncrypted which recipients cannot unwrap
updatePermission did not check share.revokedAt — could change permissions on revoked shares; also did not clean up file-ipns share_keys on downgrade
addShareKeys had no guard preventing write-share recipients from adding 'folder' keyType — recipients should only add 'file' or 'file-ipns' keys
handleUpdateFile did not call reWrapForRecipients after updating file content — share_keys held stale file keys after owner edits
Subfolder creation wrapped folder key with recipient's public key instead of owner's — owner permanently lost access to recipient-created subfolders
Defined local RequestWithUser extending NestJS Request (Fetch API) instead of importing from common/types.ts which extends Express Request
30s polling interval read from in-memory sharedItems store instead of re-fetching from API — permission changes would not be detected until manual refresh

workflow: TDD red-green cycle: stash backend agent's partial fixes, write failing tests first, verify they fail, then pop stash and confirm green
When a subagent reports classifyHandoffIfNeeded failure, spot-check SUMMARY.md existence and git commits rather than treating as real failure
Detach dev server processes from background tasks to prevent them being killed on conversation context shifts
Security review should happen immediately after feature implementation, not after PR — 12 issues found that would have merged
E2E test selector mismatches are common when writing tests without running them; always run locally before committing
OTP codes can be retrieved from API console logs when needed for manual testing during UAT checkpoints

friction: Background Bash tasks were killed multiple times when conversation context shifted, requiring repeated dev server restarts
PostgreSQL host IP changed mid-session requiring .env recreation; no .env files in the ci-debug checkout
NestJS watch mode did not reflect DTO enum changes in OpenAPI spec — required full server restart and manual verification of /api-docs-json
API client regeneration was required multiple times after DTO changes, and the generated enum didn't update until the API was fully restarted with the correct spec
Git lock file conflict during commit required manual removal
Pre-existing RequestWithUser type incompatibility in auth and device-approval controller specs caused TypeScript noise throughout the session
E2E tests required 5 iteration cycles to get all selectors correct (share-recipient-permission → recipient-perm-write, mkdir dialog → shared-inline-input-field, rename → shared-inline-rename-field)
Transient Web3Auth Core Kit init timeout caused one full E2E run to fail, requiring retry
VERIFICATION.md and tee-worker/package-lock.json were left uncommitted after phase completion and had to be caught manually
open_items: E2E tests for writable shares cover happy paths but silent revocation (403 handling, [RW]→[RO] transition, key zeroing) and 30s polling detection are not yet covered by automated tests
The 'file-ipns' keyType is cast as 'any' in the TypeORM delete call — the entity enum should be updated to include it as a proper enum value
Subfolder keys for recipient-created subfolders now add a share_key for the immediate recipient, but nested sub-subfolders may still have the same C-02 pattern
The pre-existing TypeScript error in load-test.spec.ts was fixed but there may be other pre-existing spec file errors (device-approval controller spec) still present

Rate limiting (L-03) and TEE enrollment guard (H-01) and MinLength(64) (M-01) were already implemented — security review items that appeared as findings were actually already fixed, suggesting the security review prompt needs better diff-awareness
The writable shares feature is a PoC — production hardening (key rotation on permission downgrade, IPNS key revocation, multi-writer conflict resolution beyond sequence numbers) is deferred
